MyGolfSpy 2026 slow-swing-speed forgiveness test: 9.8 (#1 in category, 95.2% playable rate) - GT1's target fitting window. Note: in MyGolfSpy's cross-field 'Top 37 Drivers Ranked for Forgiveness' (aggregating all swing speeds), GT1 ranked last (37th, 7.6) since most testers there swing faster than its intended range - forgiveness here is reported for its designed-for slow-swing-speed use case

No direct GTS2 component score found (launched June 2026, too new for full robot-test cycle); predecessor GT2 scored 8.2 overall (rank 26/37) in MyGolfSpy's Top 37 ranking despite being marketed as Titleist's 'maximum forgiveness' model; MyGolfSpy/Titleist state GTS models carry 10-15% more MOI than their GT predecessors and GTS2 has 'the highest MOI values within the current GTS lineup'

No direct GTS3 score found; predecessor GT3 scored 8.0 overall (rank 30/37) but 9.3 in MyGolfSpy's high-swing-speed-specific forgiveness test (rank 3rd of 42) - notably forgiving for an adjustable 'tour' model; GTS3 carries a claimed 10-15% MOI increase over GT3

MyGolfSpy 2024 test: 4th place finish in forgiveness scoring for the mid-swing-speed evaluation
